Problem Set: Data Structures and Algorithms

Problem 1: Binary Search
Given a sorted array, find the index of a target value using binary search.
Example: [1, 3, 5, 7, 9], target = 5 -> return 2

Problem 2: Linked List
Implement a method to detect if a linked list has a cycle.
Use Floyd's Cycle-Finding Algorithm (tortoise and hare).

Problem 3: Sorting
Sort an array using merge sort with O(n log n) time complexity.
Input: [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90]
Expected: [11, 12, 22, 25, 34, 64, 90]

Problem 4: Tree Traversal
Implement in-order traversal for a binary search tree.
Input: Root node of BST
Output: Sorted array of values

End of problem set.
